title: 'Nobody is forcing you' -- amid heavy social pressure
description: Freedom language ('you're free to choose', 'no one is forcing you') is used to wave away real, heavy social pressure to comply.
intended_goal: Secure a public 'voluntary' pledge of loyalty from each member.
expected_consequences: Members 'freely' pledge, in front of the group.
context_notes: You're free to choose; no one is forcing you. It's entirely your choice.

language_act.text: You're free to choose, of course. No one is forcing you. It's entirely your choice -- in front of everyone.
